mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-6092, -12748) and has to end up at (20639, 6438). On the way it must stop at A (Seton Hall Heliport) at (-25156, 2235), B (Staten Island University Hospital Heliport) at (-11231, -15100), C (Lembo Heliport) at (-15414, 20338), D (North Shore University Hospital Nr 2 Heliport) at (20622, 5493); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [LaGuardia Airport (KLGA, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [John F. Kennedy International Airport (KJFK, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [Teterboro Airport (KTEB, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [Newark Liberty International Airport (KEWR, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 145022 meters. The battery only allows 151737 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Taylor Field Heliport at Fort Hamilton; DEST is North Shore University Hospital Heliport.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
